# FDG9120

> CONSIDER using the Simulated Covariance Pattern if there is a need to have a representation for all instantiations of a generic type.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 9.8.3 Simulated Covariance Pattern.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library suggestion, application suggestion, test none
- Status: draft

Not machine-checkable: whether a representation of all instantiations of a generic type is needed is a design judgment.

## From the book

This pattern should not be used frivolously, because it results in additional types in the framework and can make the existing types more complex.
